rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿１９I figured you'd be training on￥your own, even on your day off.＝＠０４８＿２０Guess not. So how the heck did￥you pull off scores like that?
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿２１That's really all?＝＠０４８＿２２Well... you don't exactly look￥like you're training in secret.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿２３Yeah, maybe I did get a￥little careless...＝＠０４８＿２４I didn't think I was￥slacking, though.
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿２５Losing in your best event￥stings way worse than losing￥at anything else.＝＠０４８＿２６Dammit!!￥Next time, I'm beating you!
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿２８What'd you say?!￥Dammit!!￥I'm SO gonna beat you!!
＊Eiji＊＠０４８＿２９I won't lose next time!￥You'd better be ready!
